quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a reusable water bottle that reminds you to drink more water.
quests.correctAnswer: It buzzes gently every hour, so you never forget to drink water.
quests.hint: Mention the friendly reminder, not just the bottle itself.
quests.explanation: A simple daily habit is easy to picture, so people see the value right away.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a to-do list app that sends just one reminder each morning.
quests.correctAnswer: One clear reminder every morning helps you finish what matters most.
quests.hint: Keep the focus on simplicity, not on extra features.
quests.explanation: Promising less clutter is a strong selling point for a busy audience.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a backpack with a built-in pocket for charging your phone.
quests.correctAnswer: This backpack charges your phone as you walk, so it's never at zero.
quests.hint: Picture someone walking to work or class as you say this.
quests.explanation: Tying a feature to a familiar daily scene makes the benefit instantly clear.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an umbrella designed to stay strong in heavy wind.
quests.correctAnswer: Our umbrella bends with strong wind instead of turning inside out.
quests.hint: Name the exact problem this umbrella solves.
quests.explanation: Naming the annoying problem first makes the solution feel necessary.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that finds the cheapest nearby fuel prices.
quests.correctAnswer: It shows the cheapest fuel nearby before you even start the car.
quests.hint: Stress how much time and money the app saves.
quests.explanation: Savings that happen automatically are an easy idea for anyone to like.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that finds and cancels subscriptions you forgot about.
quests.correctAnswer: It finds forgotten subscriptions and cancels them for you in one tap.
quests.hint: Highlight how little effort the user needs to put in.
quests.explanation: Removing effort from a boring task makes the app feel essential.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a seat cushion that helps you sit with better posture.
quests.correctAnswer: This cushion gently corrects your posture the moment you start to slouch.
quests.hint: Describe the correction happening automatically, without any effort.
quests.explanation: An automatic fix removes the need for willpower, which people find appealing.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a nightlight that slowly dims to help you fall asleep.
quests.correctAnswer: Our nightlight fades slowly, so your body eases naturally into sleep.
quests.hint: Connect the gentle light change to a natural process.
quests.explanation: Linking a product to something the body already does builds instant trust.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a lunchbox with separate sections so food doesn't mix.
quests.correctAnswer: Each section stays separate, so your lunch tastes as fresh as breakfast.
quests.hint: Focus on the taste and freshness, not the design.
quests.explanation: People care about the result - fresh food - more than the container itself.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch solar garden lights that switch on by themselves at dusk.
quests.correctAnswer: These lights sense the evening and switch on by themselves - no switches at all.
quests.hint: Emphasise that the user never has to do anything.
quests.explanation: Zero-effort products are easy to picture and easy to want.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a phone case that also charges your phone as you carry it.
quests.correctAnswer: This case tops up your battery all day, so your phone is always ready.
quests.hint: Highlight the everyday convenience, not the battery technology.
quests.explanation: Focusing on the daily benefit is clearer than explaining how it works.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a kitchen bin that sorts recycling from regular waste automatically.
quests.correctAnswer: Just drop it in - this bin sorts your recycling for you every time.
quests.hint: Show how the hardest part of recycling disappears.
quests.explanation: Removing the most annoying step of a chore is a very persuasive angle.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a language app that teaches with just ten minutes a day.
quests.correctAnswer: Just ten minutes a day is all it takes to build real conversation skills.
quests.hint: Lead with the small time commitment.
quests.explanation: A small, believable time commitment removes the biggest excuse people have.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fitness app that turns daily walks into a fun game.
quests.correctAnswer: Every walk becomes a game, so staying active finally feels fun.
quests.hint: Connect the word 'fun' directly to daily exercise.
quests.explanation: Reframing exercise as fun addresses the main reason people quit.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a tool that checks your emails for grammar mistakes.
quests.correctAnswer: It catches grammar mistakes before you hit send, every single time.
quests.hint: Focus on the moment right before sending, not the grammar rules.
quests.explanation: Picturing the exact moment of relief makes the benefit feel real.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a suitcase with a weight scale built into the handle.
quests.correctAnswer: Lift the handle, and you'll know your bag's weight before the airport does.
quests.hint: Picture the moment of checking in at the airport.
quests.explanation: Solving a stressful travel moment in advance makes the product feel like a relief.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app for renting cars from local owners for a weekend.
quests.correctAnswer: Borrow a neighbour's car for the weekend for far less than a rental company charges.
quests.hint: Compare the price directly with a traditional rental company.
quests.explanation: A direct price comparison gives the listener an instant reason to care.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a walking-tour app with audio guides for exploring a new city.
quests.correctAnswer: Put in your earphones, and let the city tell you its own stories.
quests.hint: Make the city feel like it's speaking directly to the traveller.
quests.explanation: Giving the city a voice turns a simple app into a memorable experience.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a note-taking app that neatly organises your handwriting.
quests.correctAnswer: Write however you like - this app turns your notes into a tidy, searchable page.
quests.hint: Contrast messy handwriting with a clean result.
quests.explanation: Showing the before-and-after contrast makes the change easy to imagine.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a password manager that remembers every login for you.
quests.correctAnswer: Remember one password, and it handles every other login you have.
quests.hint: Highlight the trade of many passwords for just one.
quests.explanation: A clear one-for-many trade is simple to understand and instantly appealing.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a video-call app with large buttons, made for older relatives.
quests.correctAnswer: One big button connects grandma to the whole family, with no confusion at all.
quests.hint: Picture a specific person using it, not just 'users' in general.
quests.explanation: Naming a real person the product helps makes the pitch feel warm and true.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a meal-prep box with pre-measured ingredients for quick dinners.
quests.correctAnswer: Every ingredient arrives pre-measured, so dinner is ready in fifteen minutes flat.
quests.hint: Give a specific time to make the promise concrete.
quests.explanation: A specific number is far more convincing than a vague promise like 'quick.'

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an app that finds the nearest farmers' market open today.
quests.correctAnswer: It shows exactly which farmers' markets are open near you right now.
quests.hint: Stress that the information is current, not just nearby.
quests.explanation: Timeliness solves the real frustration of showing up to a closed market.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a reusable bag that keeps snacks fresh for over a week.
quests.correctAnswer: Seal it once, and your snacks stay crunchy for more than a week.
quests.hint: Use a sensory word to make the freshness feel real.
quests.explanation: A sensory detail helps the listener imagine the product working, not just believe a claim.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart plant pot that tells you exactly when to water it.
quests.correctAnswer: This pot lets you know the moment your plant actually needs water.
quests.hint: Focus on saving the plant, not on the sensor technology.
quests.explanation: People care about keeping the plant alive far more than how the pot works.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an automatic feeder that feeds your pet on a set schedule.
quests.correctAnswer: Feed your pet on time, every time, even when you're stuck at work.
quests.hint: Picture the owner running late, and the pet not noticing.
quests.explanation: Relieving a specific worry - being late - makes pet owners feel instant relief.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a doorbell camera that lets you see visitors from your phone.
quests.correctAnswer: See who's at the door from anywhere, even when you're not home.
quests.hint: Emphasise being able to check in from anywhere.
quests.explanation: Extending awareness beyond the home addresses a very common safety concern.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a budgeting app that shows exactly how much you spend on coffee each month.
quests.correctAnswer: See exactly how much your coffee habit costs you every single month.
quests.hint: Pick one everyday habit people can instantly picture.
quests.explanation: A relatable, specific example makes an abstract idea like budgeting feel personal.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a weather app that tells you the exact minute rain will start.
quests.correctAnswer: It tells you the exact minute rain will start, right down to your street.
quests.hint: Use precise timing to stand out from ordinary weather apps.
quests.explanation: Precision is the clearest way to show this app beats a standard weather app.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a digital photo frame that updates with new family photos by itself.
quests.correctAnswer: New family photos appear on the frame by themselves - no uploading required.
quests.hint: Remove the effort of uploading from the picture entirely.
quests.explanation: Promising zero effort turns a nice idea into something people actually want to own.
